title: ATSC A/85 Short-form
summary: Full-program loudness and True Peak checks for ATSC short-form content.
descriptionMarkdown: For commercials and other short-form television content measured from the full-program mix using the current BS.1770 method. ATSC publishes loudness in LKFS; PLVS displays the numerically equivalent LUFS value. The tolerance describes anticipated measurement variation and should not be treated as an alternate production target.

references.title: ATSC A/85 Techniques for Establishing and Maintaining Audio Loudness
references.relevanceMarkdown: Defines the short-form full-program measurement approach, target loudness, anticipated measurement variation and True Peak ceiling represented here.

releases.notesMarkdown: Initial curated release based on the current ATSC recommended practice.
